mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_knowledge_document WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND document_id = #{documentId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, version_no, title, publish_time FROM oa_knowledge_doc_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND document_id = #{documentId} AND deleted = 0 AND publish_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT file.file_id, file.file_name, file.file_size FROM sys_file file JOIN oa_knowledge_document document ON document.tenant_id = file.tenant_id AND document.document_id = #{documentId} JOIN sys_user uploader ON uploader.tenant_id = document.tenant_id AND uploader.user_id = document.submitter_id AND CAST(uploader.user_name AS BINARY) = CAST(file.create_by AS BINARY) WHERE file.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file.deleted = 0 AND document.deleted = 0 AND uploader.deleted = 0 AND file.access_type = 'PRIVATE' AND (file.biz_type IS NULL OR file.biz_type = '') AND file.file_type REGEXP '^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$' AND file.file_size > 0 AND file.file_id IN #{fileId} ORDER BY file.file_id
